Package model.profiles

Class ProfilesManager

java.lang.Object
model.profiles.ProfilesManager
public class ProfilesManager extends Object
The ProfilesManager class manages user profiles in the game. It handles adding, saving, reading, and selecting profiles.

    • readProfile

      public void readProfile()
      Reads profiles from the file system and adds them to the list of profiles. If no profiles are found, creates default profiles.

    • defaultProfile

      public void defaultProfile()
      Creates default profiles and adds them to the list of profiles.

    • nextProfile

      public void nextProfile()
      Advances to the next profile in the list. If the end of the list is reached, wraps around to the first profile.

    • previousProfile

      public void previousProfile()
      Moves to the previous profile in the list. If the beginning of the list is reached, wraps around to the last profile.
